question_stem: A nucleus P undergoes $\alpha$-decay to form nucleus Q.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the equation for this decay.

$$^{215}_{84}\text{P} \rightarrow ^{\_\_}_{\_\_}\text{Q} + ^{\_\_}_{\_\_}\alpha$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the principle of conservation of momentum.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Before the decay, nucleus P has a speed of $3.2 \times 10^5 \text{m s}^{-1}$. After the decay, nucleus Q is stationary.

Calculate the speed of the alpha particle after the decay.
